title: Country Road Canonical Representation
description: Rectangle grid divided into rooms by thick walls; a room may hold one number, the count of its cells the loop passes through

cells.description: m x n grid: 0 = no number, positive integer = the room number printed in that cell

h.description: (m-1) x n array: h[r][c] = thick border below cell[r][c]. 0=thin, 1=thick

v.description: m x (n-1) array: v[r][c] = thick border right of cell[r][c]. 0=thin, 1=thick
